title: The derived sections with support are computed by the derived tensor product with the sections of the structure sheaf, in finite dimension
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the derived sections with support of an arbitrary complex as the derived tensor product with the derived sections of the structure sheaf, and lists the resulting identities for a derived tensor product of two complexes together with the statement that the tensor product of two complexes supported in T is again supported in T, all under the hypothesis that the ring has finite dimension (author lemma at source lines 1162-1177, label lemma-torsion-tensor-product). The proof (source lines 1179-1203) represents both sides by explicit complexes, constructs the canonical map through the adjointness property, and then reduces the verification to shifts of the ring by combining the colimit description of the functor with the fact that it commutes with direct sums (proof lines 1190-1198); the remaining identities are formal from transitivity. The construction of the representative and the reduction to the ring are the content. H2.
